sets.notes: The card text is an imperative („Nenne zwei …“) and ends with a full stop after the closing quotation mark („Rat Pack“.); kept verbatim. Any two of the five core members (Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin, Sammy Davis Jr., Peter Lawford, Joey Bishop) are correct; Frank Sinatra und Dean Martin is the canonical pair used in the article. The siblings are likewise open pairs: any two of Pavarotti/Domingo/Carreras, of the three Gibb brothers, of ABBA's four members and of Ross/Wilson/Ballard are correct.

sets.notes: The card's count is as of mid-2019: Messi (2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2015) and Cristiano Ronaldo (2008, 2013, 2014, 2016, 2017) stood at five each, counting the FIFA World Player of the Year, the FIFA Ballon d'Or (2010–2015) and The Best FIFA award as one series. Messi won a sixth in September 2019, so the tie no longer holds today.
